records.title: 10-K 12.31.23
records.text: Passenger revenue was $48.5 billion, an increase of $3.9 billion, or 8.8%, as compared to 2022.

records.title: 10-K 12.31.23
records.text: Continued strength in demand for air travel and a 7.6% increase in revenue passenger miles (RPMs) as compared to 2022 contributed to record passenger revenue in 2023.

records.title: 10-K 12.31.23
records.text: Cargo revenue decreased $421 million, or 34.1%, in 2023 as compared to 2022, primarily due to a 29.4% decrease in cargo yield and a 6.7% decrease in cargo ton miles driven by lower demand and increased air freight capacity globally.

records.title: 10-K 12.31.23
records.text: Aircraft fuel costs were lower primarily due to a 16.3% decrease in the average price per gallon of aircraft fuel as compared to 2022.

records.title: 10-K 12.31.23
records.text: In 2022, other nonoperating income, net primarily included $424 million of non-service related pension and other postretirement benefit plan income, offset in part by $74 million of net special charges principally for mark-to-market net unrealized losses associated with certain equity investments.
